title: Directions & transport

grammar.title: Asking the way — and understanding the answer
grammar.body: Ask **¿dónde está ___?** and then catch the key words: **derecha** (right), **izquierda** (left), **derecho** (straight). For taxis, agree the fare first or ask for the meter; apps like Uber/DiDi work well in cities.

canDo: Take a taxi and ask the fare

items.note: Agree the fare before getting in.

comprehension.reply: está al fondo, a la derecha
comprehension.english: It's at the back, on the right.
comprehension.question: Where's the bathroom?
choices: At the back, on the right
